title: Approve low-risk large payments automatically
task: Reduce workflow interruptions: large payments the risk engine scores as low risk no longer wait for a person.
finding: Declared before the run as blocked in every mode but none; observed as pass in every mode. The project's own protecting test names 'system' and 'policy' as non-persons and never a risk engine, so the test the gate runs passes while the holdout test fails: VerifiedPass true, InvariantPass false. The gate verified what the repository's test could see. This is the honest miss of category J, as D1 is of D; J7 is the same change against a repository that carries the strict test.
